assumptions.resource_saver_model: Expected credited output including duplicates; ingredients divided by 1 + bonus at each recipe level. No inventory-cap refunds or per-batch rounding.
assumptions.other_non_exploration_supply: Non-explorable ingredient shortfalls must be supplied separately; listed in required_external_supply
assumptions.limitations: Expected yields are not a stochastic stopping-time estimate. No inventory caps, exploration order, Craftworks timing/slots, or automatic secondary-target selection modeled.
